logoImageUrl.label: Logo image
logoImageUrl.help: Shown in the top-left of the header. Leave empty to use the site title.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.help: Short line shown under the logo on the home page.

githubUrl.label: GitHub URL
githubUrl.help: Adds a GitHub icon link to the header.

headerMenu.label: Header menu
headerMenu.help: Name of the menu used for the top header links. Optional.

sidebarMenu.label: Sidebar menu (override)
sidebarMenu.help: Advanced: force a specific menu in the docs sidebar. Leave empty to build the sidebar automatically from your pages.

editBaseUrl.label: "Edit this page" base URL
editBaseUrl.help: Base URL used to build the edit link under each docs page. Optional.

heroTitle.label: Headline
heroTitle.help: Large heading at the top of the home page.

heroMessage.label: Sub-heading
heroMessage.help: Supporting sentence shown under the headline.

heroImageUrl.label: Hero image
heroImageUrl.help: Optional image shown beside the hero text.

asideHtml.label: Sidebar ad / sponsor
asideHtml.help: Paste an AdSense, Carbon Ads, or sponsor snippet. It appears in the right rail on docs pages.

contentFooterHtml.label: Below-content HTML
contentFooterHtml.help: Shown under every page's content — good for a newsletter box, banner ad, or reusable block.

warningHtml.label: Warning banner
warningHtml.help: Optional highlighted banner shown above the content (e.g. "This is a beta.").

embedUrl.label: Embed URL
embedUrl.help: On a Demo page, this URL is shown in a large full-width iframe (live demo, sandbox, editor…).

embedTitle.label: Embed title
embedTitle.help: Accessible title for the embedded iframe.

footerCta.label: Footer call-to-action
footerCta.help: Optional highlighted row shown above the footer.

metaDescription.label: Meta description
metaDescription.help: Default description used by search engines and social cards.

metaTitle.label: Meta title (Open Graph)
metaTitle.help: Overrides the social/search title. Defaults to the page title.

metaImage.label: Social share image
metaImage.help: og:image / Twitter card image. Defaults to the page's featured image.

metaSiteName.label: Site name (Open Graph)
metaSiteName.help: og:site_name. Defaults to the site title.

metaUrl.label: Canonical URL
metaUrl.help: Sets the canonical link and og:url.
